channel.description: Recent content in Atticus Novak: All the Latest Rock and Metal News on Loud Legends

item.title: How One EMBARRASSING Night at 'Whiskey A Go Go' Forced LINKIN PARK to Find CHESTER BENNINGTON
item.description: Linkin Park rose to become one of the most influential rock bands of the 21st century. Known for blending heavy guitar riffs, hip-hop beats, and electronic layers, the group built a sound that was both accessible and intense.

item.title: LIMP BIZKIT's WES BORLAND Cosplays As Skull-Faced JAMES HETFIELD At Metallica’s Denver Show
item.description: Limp Bizkit guitarist Wes Borland turned heads at Metallica’s Denver show on Friday by dressing up like a skull-faced version of 1980s James Hetfield (watch below). The look included a “Metal Up Your Ass” t-shirt and white high-top sneakers, all while performing a full 10-song set.

item.title: SOL INVICTO, Featuring Members Of DEFTONES And CYPRESS HILL, Releases Visualizer For 21-Minute Track 'Initium'
item.description: After more than a decade locked away in a private fan archive, SOL INVICTO has finally released Initium, a 21-minute experimental track recorded in 2011 (watch it below).

item.title: AC/DC Opens European Tour in Prague, Czech President Attends; VIDEOS
item.description: AC/DC launched the summer leg of their “Power Up” European tour Thursday night in Prague, Czech Republic. The concert took place at Letiště Praha Letňany and drew an estimated crowd of 60,000 people.

item.title: AC/DC Adds More Australian Shows As Fans Struggle With Ticket Website Issues
item.description: AC/DC has added three new dates to its upcoming Power Up tour in Australia. The new shows are scheduled for: November 16 in Melbourne at Melbourne Cricket Ground November 25 in Sydney at Accor Stadium December 18 in Brisbane at Suncorp Stadium Fans can find tickets and all official dates at acdc.

item.title: WOLFGANG VAN HALEN Explains Why He Backed Out of OZZY OSBOURNE’s Final Concert: 'I Wouldn’t Be Able To Pull It Off'
item.description: Wolfgang Van Halen, son of late guitar legend Eddie Van Halen, was originally scheduled to appear at Ozzy Osbourne’s farewell concert, Back to the Beginning, on July 5 in Birmingham, U.

item.title: Metallica's KIRK HAMMETT Recalls Struggling With 'The Unforgiven': 'I Wasn't Prepared For It'
item.description: Metallica guitarist Kirk Hammett is known for writing some of the band’s most famous guitar parts, but not every one came easy. In a recent interview with Metal Hammer, he opened up about the difficulties he faced while working on the solo for “The Unforgiven”, one of the standout tracks from the band’s 1991 self-titled release, often called “The Black Album.

item.title: SCORPIONS/Ex-MOTÖRHEAD MIKKEY DEE Admits He Felt Lost Playing With KING DIAMOND: 'I Was A Lousy Drummer'
item.description: Mikkey Dee, born Micael Kiriakos Delaoglou in Gothenburg, Sweden, got his big break playing drums for King Diamond. But in a recent interview with Rock Kommander (transcribed by LOUDLEGENDS.

item.title: JAKE E. LEE Asks Fans Not To Judge OZZY OSBOURNE’s Performance: 'He Deserves This Farewell'
item.description: Guitarist Jake E. Lee is urging fans to show compassion ahead of Back to the Beginning, the farewell concert for Ozzy Osbourne and the original Black Sabbath lineup.

item.title: When MAX CAVALERA Almost Reunited With SEPULTURA: 'We'll Cross Paths Again'
item.description: Max Cavalera is best known for helping create one of Brazil’s most influential metal bands: Sepultura. But in 1996, after years of success, he walked away from it all.

item.title: Creed's SCOTT STAPP On Viral Revival: 'It Started Online Before We Even Noticed'
item.description: Scott Stapp says the Creed reunion didn’t start with a grand plan or a flashy PR campaign. It began with the internet doing its thing. In a recent interview (via Meltdown), the singer explained that the band started to see signs of renewed interest around 2020, when clips, memes, and jokes about Creed started to go viral.

item.title: AC/DC Announces 2025 Stadium Tour of Australia With Amyl and The Sniffers
item.description: AC/DC is heading back to their roots. The legendary Australian rock band has announced a five-city stadium tour across the country for November and December 2025. This will be their first Australian tour in ten years.

item.title: AMY LEE Says New EVANESCENCE Album Coming 'Probably Early Next Year'
item.description: Evanescence is working on their next studio album, and according to Amy Lee, it’s likely to arrive in early 2026. The singer gave an update during a recent interview with WDHA-FM 105.

item.title: Linkin Park’s EMILY ARMSTRONG Shaves Fan's Head on Stage at ROCK FOR PEOPLE 2025
item.description: Linkin Park opened their summer festival season with a big moment at Rock for People 2025. The band performed in front of 50,000 fans, but one person in the crowd definitely stood out.

item.title: The AC/DC Song They’d Rather Pretend NEVER HAPPENED: 'Really Soft Stuff'
item.description: “But the answer was literally on the other side.” Back when AC/DC hadn’t yet locked in the sound that would make them gods to some and repetitive to others, they were still fumbling through the dark.

item.title: CHARLIE BENANTE Says BLACK SABBATH Helped Shape ANTHRAX’s Sound: 'We Covered Sabbath Bloody Sabbath'
item.description: Anthrax drummer Charlie Benante pointed to Black Sabbath as a key influence on the band’s formative sound, recalling how their admiration for the Birmingham pioneers led them to cover Sabbath Bloody Sabbath during a formative period in their career.

item.title: DAVID ELLEFSON Says MEGADETH Took Credit For 'Soldier On!': 'Just Wiped My Name Off'
item.description: David Ellefson isn’t done unpacking his past with Megadeth,and he’s brought receipts. In a new interview with The Delz Show, the former bassist draws some not-so-subtle contrasts between how Metallica handled songwriting credits with Dave Mustaine and how Mustaine allegedly did the opposite when it came to Megadeth’s own track, Soldier On!

item.title: IRON MAIDEN Fans Slam 50th Anniversary Tour: 'Most Predictable Setlist Possible'
item.description: Iron Maiden launched their Run for Your Lives 50th anniversary tour on May 27 in Budapest, Hungary. Grab Your Tickets Here. The show introduced Simon Dawson behind the drums, stepping in after Nicko McBrain retired in late 2024.

item.title: How LEMMY KILMISTER Helped Invent THRASH METAL With ACE OF SPADES
item.description: By the late 1970s, rock had ballooned into a spectacle of arena shows, towering stage sets, and endless guitar acrobatics. Meanwhile tucked away in sweaty basements and smoky pubs, a small group of musicians were chasing something far less polished.

item.title: DAVE MUSTAINE Says FAITH NO MORE's Mike Patton Is 'An Unprofessional Jerk'
item.description: Dave Mustaine has spent over 40 years running the Megadeth machine as guitarist, vocalist, songwriter, and self-appointed keeper of thrash metal’s purity. In that time, he’s built not only an impressive discography, but a side hustle in speaking his mind with the grace of a sledgehammer.

item.title: Inside Halestorm’s Risky Recording Process for New Album Everest
item.description: Halestorm walked into Everest with a backpack full of unfinished songs. Turns out, producer Dave Cobb didn’t want any of it. “We’re not doing demos. I hate demos,” he told them.

item.title: Ted Nugent on His Never-Ending Tour Life: “I Never Used the R-Word”
item.description: Ted Nugent, 76 years old and still grinding away, is back on stage after his farewell tour. Not because he changed his mind. Because, according to him, he never used the word retire.

item.title: Dave Mustaine Confirms Megadeth’s Album 17 Is Taking Shape—205 Songs Under Review
item.description: Alright folks, gather ‘round—Dave Mustaine has spoken. And when Dave speaks, metalheads listen… usually while arguing on the internet about which Megadeth lineup was best. (If you said “Super Collider era,” we need to talk.

item.title: My Ticket Home to Play First Show Since 2018—Here’s What to Expect
item.description: Let’s be real. Band reunions? They happen. All. The. Time. Some of them feel like a warm, nostalgic hug. Others? Like a desperate cash grab at the last scraps of remember-us-please energy.

item.title: Mercyful Fate Begins Work on First Album Since 1999, With Instrumentals Complete and Lyrics Next on the Agenda
item.description: After 26 long years, the wait for new music from Mercyful Fate may finally be nearing an end. While whispers of a fresh release from King Diamond and the band have been circulating for a while, bassist Becky Baldwin recently provided an update that confirms things are moving forward.

item.title: OnlyFans and Rock: Lorraine Lewis, The FEMME FATALE singer, embraces her wild side with new content
item.description: Lorraine Lewis isn’t just standing still. She’s moving, shaking things up, and dragging rock and roll with her (kicking and screaming, probably). You remember her, right? The voice behind FEMME FATALE.

item.title: Andrés 'Hades' Adasme of Lucifer’s Hammer Dead at 38
item.description: Andrés “Hades” Adasme—a name that’s been synonymous with Lucifer’s Hammer since 2012. The voice. The energy. The force behind four blistering albums. Now, at just 38, he’s gone.

item.title: Teemu Mäntysaari Discusses Progress on Megadeth's New Album
item.description: Megadeth’s next album? Already in motion. Ideas everywhere, so many good ones, it seems. Guitarist Teemu Mäntysaari, speaking with Megadeth Digital, paints a picture of a band creating across continents.

item.title: Courtney LaPlante: "Women Have More Chances Than Ever" to Win a Grammy
item.description: When you’ve been around the block as long as I have, you get used to hearing musicians gush about their “most ambitious project yet.” But Courtney LaPlante, frontwoman of Spiritbox, might actually have a point with her upcoming album, Tsunami Sea, dropping March 7, 2025, via Pale Chord and Rise Records.

item.title: My Chemical Romance Drummer Bob Bryar Found Dead in Tennessee
item.description: The news of Bob Bryar’s passing feels like a gut punch to those who remember his explosive drumming during My Chemical Romance’s most iconic era. At just 44, Bryar was found dead in his Tennessee home on November 26.

item.title: Linkin Park’s Mike Shinoda: “Our New Lineup Came Together Naturally”
item.description: Linkin Park is back. New album (listen below). New lineup. Same vibe. This one’s called “From Zero”, which feels like a bit of an oversell for a band that’s been rehashing itself since 2017.

item.title: Phil Sgrosso Joins Mass Departure from As I Lay Dying; See Details
item.description: Phil Sgrosso has left As I Lay Dying behind, joining the recent exodus from a band that now stands with only Tim Lambesis on board. After nearly two decades of dedication split across two stints—2003 to 2014, and again from 2018 to now—Sgrosso decided it was time to step back.

item.title: Watch: Linkin Park Drops "Over Each Other" Video as Controversy Looms Large
item.description: The clock is ticking. Linkin Park’s upcoming album, From Zero, is just weeks away from hitting shelves. It’s their first full-length release since 2017’s One More Light and their first step forward following Chester Bennington’s death.

item.title: Judas Priest's Rob Halford: "Political Debates Are Harder Than Ever"
item.description: Rob Halford had plenty to say about today’s polarized political landscape during a recent chat with Los Angeles Times En Español. In typical Halford fashion, he dove headfirst into the fact that a large portion of the metal community leans conservative, and he can’t help but be bemused by it.

item.title: Watch: Linkin Park Partners with Riot Games for League of Legends Anthem
item.description: Linkin Park is back, boys and girls. Again. This time, they’ve teamed up with Riot Games for “Heavy Is The Crown,” the official anthem for the League of Legends 2024 World Championship.

item.title: Watch: New Sound, New Faces: Linkin Park Rocks Jimmy Fallon; VIDEO
item.description: Linkin Park hit Jimmy Fallon’s stage last night (17) with their new single, “The Emptiness Machine.” If you missed it, don’t worry. It’s online, complete with enough fog to choke a small village.

item.title: Jaime Bennington, Chester Bennington's Son Calls Out Linkin Park
item.description: Linkin Park thought they were shaking things up by naming Emily Armstrong their new vocalist, but it’s more like they kicked a hornet’s nest while blindfolded. Fans aren’t just upset—they’re seething.

item.title: Linkin Park Breaks Silence on Rob Bourdon’s Departure
item.description: If you haven’t already heard, Linkin Park is back. And no, this isn’t some watered-down reunion tour cash grab. The band has recruited Dead Sara’s Emily Armstrong as their new vocalist, with Colin Brittain stepping in on drums.

item.title: Linkin Park is Back with a New Album and Unexpected Vocalist
item.description: Leave it to Linkin Park to make their return a three-ring circus. A flashy new album, a shiny logo, and a brand-new vocalist, Emily Armstrong, were all unveiled during a livestream that pulled over 100,000 viewers on YouTube and an extra 26,000 on Instagram.

item.title: Linkin Park’s Mysterious Countdown Leaves Fans Baffled
item.description: What are they doing? Seriously. Saturday rolls around, and boom—Linkin Park drops a post that’s as exciting as a loading screen. A countdown. Plain white numbers on a black background.

item.title: Korn Invites Fans to Create Art for 30th Anniversary—See How You Can Get Involved
item.description: Seems like Korn is dusting off the nostalgia box and pulling out another fan art contest—this time to mark 30 years of Korn wreaking havoc on the rock scene.

item.title: Korn's Hits Get a Lo-Fi Makeover, And They Approve
item.description: Korn gave a nod of approval to a recent lo-fi album (listen below) of covers that takes their iconic tracks like “Freak on a Leash” and “Blind” and, let’s be honest, strips them down to something that feels like you should be sipping coffee in some indie café.

item.title: Corey Taylor on Why Slipknot Chose Eloy Casagrande as Their New Drummer
item.description: Slipknot’s decision to bring in Eloy Casagrande, formerly of Sepultura, as their new drummer has sparked plenty of chatter. Let’s be honest—watching his relentless, jaw-dropping drum videos circulating online, it’s hard to argue they didn’t find their guy.

item.title: Metallica's Kirk Hammett Declares Judas Priest the True Founders of Heavy Metal
item.description: Kirk Hammett isn’t here to play revisionist history with metal. When the drummer Carmine Appice tossed out the claim that heavy metal only began with Metallica, some folks had a field day.

item.title: AS I LAY DYING’s New Album Delayed: Tim Lambesis Explains Why
item.description: Tim Lambesis, AS I LAY DYING’s frontman, recently chatted on the Loaded Radio podcast about the band’s long-gestating new album. Apparently, the record’s been done for a while, but mixing has turned into a never-ending tug-of-war.

item.title: Brian “Head” Welch Explains Korn’s Shift to Seven-String Guitars
item.description: Korn’s signature seven-string guitar sound didn’t start with some grand plan to revolutionize metal. No, it all began because James “Munky” Shaffer had a thing for Steve Vai, and Brian “Head” Welch?

item.title: Linkin Park Rumored to Return with a Female Lead Singer
item.description: July marks seven years since Chester Bennington’s untimely passing—a moment that shattered not just his family and friends, but the entire world of Linkin Park fans. His death wasn’t just tragic; it was a full stop.

item.title: Watch: Metallica Drops New “Too Far Gone?” Video with Tour Highlights
item.description: Metallica might’ve dropped 72 Seasons a mere five months back, but the internet reaction could’ve fooled anyone into thinking it’s been years since that release. One side hollered about “disastrous trash,” while the other shrugged, calling it “pretty decent.

item.title: Metallica’s Lars Ulrich on Tour, Streaming Records, and Band Longevity
item.description: Lars Ulrich is no stranger to marveling at Metallica’s unlikely ride to the top. As their colossal M-72 tour rolls on, the drummer recently shared some reflections with FOX 10, and let’s just say, humility is still in the air.

item.title: As I Lay Dying Recruits Nick Pierce as Drummer for Tour; See Details
item.description: Jordan Mancino, the drummer who’s been part of As I Lay Dying since the beginning, has decided to step away from the band’s upcoming Two Decades of Destruction Tour.

item.title: Brian Welch Reveals Korn’s "Exciting News" Is Coming Soon
item.description: Brian “Head” Welch, guitarist for Korn, has been dropping hints about something “really exciting” on the horizon. Back in December, he mentioned big plans brewing for 2021. Now, in a chat with Kerrang!
